caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a medium brown color. The front panel of the chest features three vertically-oriented sections, each adorned with intricate carved patterns. The carvings on the two outer sections depict symmetrical, stylized leafy plants with arched tops, while the center section shows a different, more elongated floral or botanical design, also symmetric. Between these sections are vertical carved bands with a repeating leaf or feather motif. The top edge of the chest is bordered by a horizontal band with a swirling scroll design that matches a similar band along the bottom front edge, both also carved in relief. The side panel visible in the image has simpler recessed rectangular sections without ornate carving. The background is plain, and the chest is rendered with shading and detail to represent its three-dimensional form and carved decoration.
title: Chest
